conditions.evidence: 160 patients with a single sporadic Vestibular Schwannoma (VS)
conditions.label: Vestibular Schwannoma

modalities.evidence: Segmentation of Vestibular Schwannoma from Magnetic Resonance Imaging

output.population: 160 patients with a single sporadic Vestibular Schwannoma referred from 10 medical sites and consecutively seen at a single center, with 428 timepoints and 487 3D-images.
output.summary: Routine clinical MRI from multiple scanners and vendors with manual expert-validated segmentations of vestibular schwannoma, including intrameatal and extrameatal components, across repeated timepoints for automatic surveillance research.
